description: Returns workspace metadata: hierarchy (spaces/folders/lists), members, plan, seats, shared items, custom task types. Use search_member to find a specific member by name/email. Use get_workspace_seats for seat-only queries. DO NOT use to find tasks — use get_workspace_tasks instead.

include_hierarchy.description: Include the full hierarchy of spaces, folders, and lists as a formatted tree (Default: true)

search_member.description: Fuzzy search for a member by name or email

team_id.description: The ClickUp Team ID or Workspace Name to use. If provided, the server will switch to this workspace for this and subsequent requests in the current session.

name: get_workspace
